title: friendslop
author: AirportLoo
selftext: Hey guys, I am working on a new AI driven version of roblox. The idea is simple, people generate games with AI, and I do the hosting, Just like Roblox. The idea is to provide a new hub to capture players, enable more creators, and have more child safety in mind. Im calling it [friendslop.world](http://friendslop.world) since its a world of friendslop games, and its meant to be easy to remember. Ive already made a big portion of it, if anyone here has any critiques, ideas, or is interested to be a developer its is free of charge ofcourse.
